description: MAX-308 s11 (a): advance cursor on bad CRC — ESP collector must not move the per-node cursor when a LOG block fails CRC/decode.
MAX-308 s11 (b): treat reset seq rollback as corruption without checking boot_id — a new boot_id with seq restarting at 0 must be accepted as a new generation (not a protocol error / not a gap).
MAX-308 s11 (c): omit TCA close — after a REMOTE log transaction behind the TCA9548A the channel must be closed/restored per the existing contract.
MAX-308 s11 (d): poll the same node first forever (the next iteration never starts at the next routable node): collector fairness / round-robin start node.

MAX-308 s11 (e): treat every ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE as NACK — on IDF 5.5 i2c_bus v2 a NACK is ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE like a timeout; classification must use the existing probe-based MAX-248 logic, not blanket mapping.

MAX-308 s11 (f): keep the raw transfer error for an absent node instead of the classified NACK - an absent node's NACK must be classified as ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND (so it does NOT trigger the MAX-243 destructive bus clear).
MAX-308 s11 (g): remove retry bound — retries after a transport fault must be bounded.

MAX-308 s11 (h): serialize native struct/padding as wire format — the codec must encode explicit little-endian fields; a mutation replacing an explicit field encode with memcpy of a struct (or equivalent layout change) must be caught by golden-vector tests.
